question: Are source-electron conversion and native count covariance identifiable from pinned selection SCI/WHT cutouts, exposure metadata and public drizzle provenance?
competing_predictions: Exact per-input gain/time/calibration and overlap coefficients are recoverable; propagate known-source photon covariance and rerun <=4 fixed diagnostic sites
Published SCI/WHT summary collapses input weights/calibration; demonstrate missing information and constructive nonidentifiability, stop without enlarging gain grid
expected_information_gain: Resolve whether previous gain-dominated pilot can acquire physical uncertainty rather than merely assumed output-grid shot noise
input_policy: Reuse pinned actual selection/deep cutouts and primary FITS headers; <=bounded public source/headers, verify bytes/identities/hashes; no author contact
stopping: No new scene selection, full-image downloads, broad trial expansion or population claims; if exact native source transport cannot be reconstructed identify required products/maps and mathematically supported uncertainty bounds
classification_audit: Audit model-family truth labels and existing denominators; unknown observed stellar/galaxy/blend labels must remain unknown and no contamination fraction inferred
